title: Lesson 5: Stakeholder Mapping: Who Has to Say Yes, and Who Has to Live With It
description: The craft of mapping every stakeholder an agent implementation touches: users, owners, IT, and compliance. Who must approve the deployment, who has to work with it every day, and how to win both before you build.

questions.question: Which statement best reflects the lesson’s guidance?
options: A consultant who can frame value but cannot navigate stakeholders will watch deal after deal die in an approval meeting they never saw coming.
There is a short way to say what stakeholder mapping is, and it comes down to two questions you ask about every person involved in an implementation.
Lesson 4 taught you how to turn what an agent does into a number a buyer can defend.

This lesson is about what happens after you have a sponsor who wants the value: the far less glamorous work of mapping every person who can stop the project, and every person who has to live with the result.
